metadata.summary: Chest X-ray database comprising 108,948 frontal-view X-ray images from 32,717 unique patients, with weakly-supervised multi-label annotations for 8 (later expanded to 14) thoracic diseases, text-mined from radiological reports using NLP.
metadata.purpose: Supporting weakly-supervised classification and localization of common thorax diseases using deep learning.

papers.title: ChestX-ray8 / NIH ChestX-ray14 — Hospital-scale Chest X-ray Database and Benchmarks on Weakly-Supervised Classification and Localization of Common Thorax Diseases

ethics.privacy_measures: Data de-identified per HIPAA Safe Harbor standards.

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.
pending_verification: geography.countries is heuristically inferred from limitation text; requires manual verification

known_limitations: Single-center origin limits generalizability to other institutions, devices, or populations.
Weak supervision introduces label noise and uncertainty in disease presence/localization.
No demographic metadata provided (age, sex, ethnicity), precluding subgroup analysis.
Frontal-view only; lateral or oblique views excluded.
bias_and_limitations.modifications: Labels generated via NLP from reports; no image preprocessing or synthetic data generation described.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: 90%+ from single U.S. federal hospital (NIH Clinical Center); no evidence of geographic, demographic, or institutional diversity.
bias_and_limitations.long_tail_classes: Class distribution skewed; some diseases (e.g., 'Hernia') have very few positive samples.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Limited generalizability outside NIH Clinical Center due to single-center, device-, and protocol-specific acquisition; no longitudinal or multi-version shift analysis reported.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: No subgroup coverage data reported (e.g., age, sex, race, geography beyond NIHCC).
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: Demographic and clinical covariate data (e.g., age, sex, ethnicity, comorbidities) are missing or unreported.

tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Tasks requiring precise anatomical localization (e.g., segmentation) or fine-grained diagnosis without additional validation, due to weak supervision.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Images selected from PACS at NIH Clinical Center; patients included based on availability of frontal-view chest X-rays with associated radiological reports.

population.target_population: Patients undergoing frontal-view chest X-ray at NIH Clinical Center
population.inclusion_criteria: Frontal-view chest X-ray with associated radiological report in PACS.
population.missing_groups: Demographic subgroups (e.g., age, sex, ethnicity, geographic origin beyond NIHCC) are not reported; representativeness beyond the single U.S. federal hospital is unknown.

attribute_recording.unknown_proportion: Demographic attributes were not reported in source text.

annotation.annotation_method: Text-mined from radiological reports using natural language processing (NLP).
annotation.labeling_provenance: Labels derived from radiological reports via NLP; known to be weakly supervised (no pixel-level or bounding-box ground truth).
annotation.label_noise_description: Labels are noisy due to reliance on imperfect NLP extraction from free-text reports; no manual verification reported.
